offering_description.value: Sells refrigerants and refrigeration equipment and provides refrigerant reclamation, recovery and management services to HVAC and refrigeration contractors, facility operators and industrial users. It reclaims used refrigerant to resell and handles recovery and disposal, earning money on product sales and service fees.

primary_services.value: refrigerant reclamation; refrigerant recovery; refrigerant management; technical services

customer_segment.value: B2B: HVAC and refrigeration contractors, commercial and industrial facility operators, refrigerant distributors

end_markets.value: commercial refrigeration; HVAC; industrial refrigeration; food processing; cold storage

revenue_model.value: product sales: refrigerants and refrigeration equipment sold to contractors and distributors; service fees: refrigerant reclamation, recovery and disposal services

value_chain_position.value: distributor: sells refrigerants bought from producers and reclaimed refrigerant to contractors and distributors; service provider: takes in used refrigerant from customers and reclaims it for reuse

geography_served.value: US national: nationwide United States, with some sales into Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: refrigerants, refrigerant reclamation and recovery services, and refrigeration equipment and parts

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: national accounts and contractors served by sales staff; distributors / dealers: wholesale refrigerant and HVAC distributors; own locations: reclamation facilities and regional sales and service branches
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: EPA Clean Air Act Section 608 and AIM Act refrigerant rules, plus DOT hazardous materials transport rules

notes: Product and geographic mix may have changed since my information was last updated.
